DREAM BIG Early Goal Setting (EGS)

Early Goal Setting: DREAM BIG

“No student should be left unguided and no one should be left behind”

Empowering first-year university students to discover career pathways, stay accountable with regular check-ins, and achieve their highest aspirations.
